Frequently Asked Questions

How is pricing calculated?

Pricing depends on location, size, frequency, and service type. You receive a clear custom offer after the consultation.

Which areas do you serve?

We serve Vienna and Graz. Ask us to confirm availability for your area.

Do I need a long-term contract?

No. We offer flexible plans, from one-time jobs to recurring service agreements.

How quickly can service start?

In most cases, we can start within a few days after confirming your plan.
